details.exclusionRule: Scalars, plain objects, arrays nested outside the declared sectorBalanceSheets.lineItems expansion, and the declared forecastAssumptions/forecastRisks aliases are excluded because they are not independent object-store records.
details.identityRule: Top-level identity is collection:id (or collection:index fallback); ledger line identity is sectorBalanceSheets:lineId:line:index.
details.deduplicationRule: No valid revision is removed. Duplicate identity, duplicate object reference, duplicate ID within a store, duplicate business key within a store, and cross-store reused IDs are diagnosed explicitly. Same ID in different semantic stores is retained as a collision diagnostic unless it is the same object reference.
